messages:
jamie: Quick FYI — evening release scheduled 2025-06-15 23:00 UTC (image: inference-service:v3.2.1). Oncall handoff at 22:45 UTC. No DB migrations. Canary in us-west1 -> eu-west1 -> ap-southeast1, 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m. Expected risk: small perf variability with new batching tweak. Please add rollout watchers and keep merges to main paused from 22:30-00:30 UTC.

sahil: ack. I can be primary watcher for the first hour. What smoke checks do you want?

jamie: thanks. Quick smoke checklist:
```
# smoke curl
curl -sS https://inference.api/redwood/health | jq .status
# sample gen
curl -sS -X POST https://inference.api/redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":10}'
```
Also watch token latency and error rate (>3% error or latency p50 >200ms -> escalate).

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window created: 2025-06-15T23:00:00Z. Canary steps: 10m step, auto-rollback enabled.

maria: @jamie I can cover 22:45-00:30 (primary). I'll run the smoke checks and watch metrics. :thumbsup:

tony: I'll be backup 22:45-01:30. If we see increased 5xxs, I'll start rollback. What's the rollback command?

jamie: rollback: `kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/inference:v3.2.0 -n prod` — keep me and @maria in the loop. If auto-rollback triggers, notify via #incidents.

sahil: noted. Also tagging eng-sre for routing check: @sre-team please confirm LB draining policy is 60s for canary pods.

eng-sre: confirmed, LB drain is 60s. We'll keep an eye on pod churn.

jamie: cool. Remember freeze window: no merges to main from 22:30-00:30 UTC unless urgent. I'll post a short post-deploy summary 00:45 UTC. Thanks all.

maria: got it — I'll open a thread update once canary starts. Good luck :rocket:

tony: :ok_hand:
